about: Bonsai 1.0b represents a paradigm shift in decentralized AI, pioneering Native 1-bit Binary Logic. By constraining weights to -1 or +1, it eliminates computationally heavy Matrix Multiplication in favor of hyper-efficient additions. This allows massive language models to achieve GPU-level speeds natively on standard CPUs. Processing everything locally, Bonsai 1.0b guarantees 100% data privacy, minimal memory footprint, and extreme energy efficiency for edge-first sovereign deployment.

bonsai1.0:1.7b.name: Bonsai 1.0b 1.7B
bonsai1.0:1.7b.description: The Bonsai 1.0b 1.7B utilizes native 1-bit binary quantization (-1 and +1) for addition-based processing. It requires 300MB of active VRAM for offline edge inference on IoT and wearables. It runs locally with lower power consumption compared to FP16 models.

bonsai1.0:8b.name: Bonsai 1.0b 8B
bonsai1.0:8b.description: The Bonsai 1.0b 8B is a powerhouse of the 1-bit binary frontier, delivering desktop-class intelligence with a mobile footprint. Executing entirely on -1 and +1 weights, this 8 billion parameter model uses only ~1.0GB of RAM. It eliminates floating-point overhead, providing blazing-fast, offline reasoning on standard CPUs and laptops. Featuring a massive 64k context window, it is the definitive enterprise engine for secure, zero-latency coding assistance and local document analysis.

bonsai1.0:27b.name: Bonsai 1.0b 27B
bonsai1.0:27b.description: The Bonsai 1.0b 27B brings massive 27 billion parameter intelligence to standard devices. Utilizing pure 1-bit binary quantization, it compresses to ~3.5GB. Designed for extreme edge deployment without cloud dependence.
